name: Koshadou Haruka
source:
"You're such a good and gentle girl. I'm happy that you became my Sister."

A fifth-year student, which is the highest year at Ieva Girls' School. He is Erena's roommate in the dormitory. He is the school's Madonna, who combines both glamour and beauty, and is also the top star of the Yokohama Revue. He gets into a sisterhood relationship, called "Esu," with Erena.

He is the head of the Koshadou family, an Onmyoji family that has existed since the Heian period (794-1185). He is in pursuit of a demon that needs to be subdued.

[Translated from [url=https://www.otomate.jp/chouchoujiken/chara/index1.php]official website[/url]]
